subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the coupled assertion fixes, do the workflow and security owners approve this grouped set of third-party action revisions for privileged automation?
rationale: The PR carries a protected security label and changes executable dependencies in secops-owned and privileged workflows, so upstream identity checks cannot replace repository-owner acceptance.

options.title: Repair and owner-review
options.body: Update every stale assertion, complete exact-head workflow validation, and obtain applicable owner approval before merge.

options.title: Replace the bot branch
options.body: Use a stable maintainer-controlled grouped dependency update if Dependabot rebases continue discarding coupled repairs.

recommendation.title: Repair and owner-review
recommendation.body: Update every stale assertion, complete exact-head workflow validation, and obtain applicable owner approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Git history directly ties this person to the exact-pin assertions requiring repair, while team-level security approval remains applicable.
